evidence_plan.requirement: Definition of an unordered text document
Existence of unordered text documents in real-world corpora

payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition of unordered text documents and confirms their existence in real-world applications.

claims.text: An unordered text document is one that lacks a specific structure and can contain sentences in any order.
Unordered text documents arise in real-world corpora and are common in various text processing applications.
